_notes.emitsInitialTool: Marlin's T word selects an EXTRUDER, not a cutter. Emitting T1 is not a no-op: it is a different command that most CNC-flavoured builds reject.
_notes.maxSpindleSpeed: The RPM the spindle reaches at full duty: S = RPM / maxSpindleSpeed x spindle.scale. At 255 any RPM from 255 up is full power - set the spindle's real top RPM.
_notes.spindle: A spindle or router on a fan output: M106 sets the PWM duty, M107 stops it.
_notes.dwellUnit: G4 P is milliseconds on Marlin; S would be seconds.
_notes.rotary: Marlin has no G93 and its extra-axis support is build-dependent. Axis replacement (rotary on the Y driver, steps/mm calibrated) is the only route worth declaring.
_notes.endCode: M107, not M5: M5 does not stop a spindle on M106, and nothing else stops it at the end of the program.
